summary: Ligand Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K reporting entry into Amendment No. 1 to the Agreement and Plan of Merger with XOMA Royalty Corporation and a newly formed HoldCo. The amendment adds HoldCo, a wholly-owned subsidiary of XOMA Royalty, as a party to facilitate a holding company reorganization under Nevada law, after which Merger Sub will merge into HoldCo with HoldCo surviving as a wholly-owned Ligand subsidiary. No deal price, premium, or advisor is stated. The transaction is subject to XOMA Royalty stockholder approval via proxy statement. Watch for stockholder vote and regulatory clearance.
